note: Campground at a tubing outfitter on the Wisconsin River north of Wisconsin Dells: a front row of river sites with gravel pads under tall bank trees, an inner row behind, and seasonal sites at the north end. Bar with a river-view patio, tube, canoe and kayak rentals and a boat launch. The campground floods at times, and campers may then be moved to higher ground. --Claude
summary: Operator pages, FAQ and ParkWith.us engine read: camper site $50 confirmed (2-night minimum, 3 on holidays), 6 a site max, military 10% on the engine; hookups 20 A / no water -> 30/50 A + water at every site; 35 nightly sites (24 RV + 11 tent; was 25), back-in; showers and dump confirmed; season ~May 20-Sep 15 -> May 1-Oct 15 (engine). Riverview kept (river row under continuous canopy). Google 4.8 (701).
flags: PRICE GATE: $50 a night for a camper site (operator page, current site with 2026 banners) - at the line, not over; tax 5.5% and the engine's 8% service fee are on top (not counted). Military 10% off with ID on the engine. Google Maps 'Point Bluff Tubing Resort' 4.8 (701; the listing covers the tubing business too); RV Life 5*/$$ stored. Presence: operator website + phone 608-253-6181 + ParkWith.us engine.

LONG-STAY: seasonal sites exist ('Seasonal Sites are full right now! We do have a waiting list'; $1,500 a year) - about 24 seasonal pads on the map against 35 sites sold nightly (~59% nightly). Passes; nothing discourages nightly guests.
MINIMUM: the camping page says '(two night minimum)' on every site type (standing 2-night, under the 3-night drop line); the engine enforces only 2 on weekends.

WATERFRONT: riverview kept. The river row (sites 1-13, centre ~43.7888,-89.8722) runs perpendicular to the Wisconsin River; on leaf-off Esri imagery the pads end ~15-25 m from the water, but NAIP leaf-on shows continuous canopy over the pads and bank, and a sandy lane runs below the pad ends. Continuous canopy = view, so no upgrade. The operator calls it 'Located on the banks of the Wisconsin River' (re-audit lead only if a leaf-on photo shows the water open from a pad).

FLOODING: FAQ 'With the campground being so close to the river we are prone at times to some flooding. We may have to move you to higher ground if the campground is too wet or underwater.' Put in the note.

PIN: stored 43.7877,-89.8713 is in woods ~170 m SE of the river row, near the County Z bridge; the river row is at ~43.7888,-89.8722 and the office/bar (Google) at 43.7899,-89.8728. Under 250 m, but ~43.7890,-89.8724 would sit on the sites.
